questions.prompt: Read the text and decide if each sentence is true or false.
questions.explanation: The text says growth 'tells us little about well-being' and rich countries 'report high levels of stress'.
questions.passage: The economist argued that economic growth, long considered the main measure of progress, tells us little about well-being. Countries with high incomes, she noted, often report high levels of stress, while some poorer nations show greater life satisfaction.

statements.text: The economist thinks growth is a perfect measure of progress.
Rich countries can still have high stress levels.
